scientific_unit: independent task-to-successful-policy mapping; episodes and trajectories are state coverage, not additional mappings

nonheld_paired_policy_evidence.interpretation: The bank supplies broad successful-policy mappings even though every identity was seen by source. It may train shared Stage 1 components but cannot by itself prove source-unseen adaptation.

combined_mapping_contract.leave_task_out_role: target train24 fold0 held5; privileged frozen inference only
combined_mapping_contract.task_weighting: each of the 90 mappings has equal shared-gradient weight; multiple members or trajectories do not increase task weight
combined_mapping_contract.task_namespace_requirement: source90 and target40 identities remain namespaced for asset ownership; numeric IDs are never model inputs

reusable_without_regeneration: frozen Stage 0 native plus Action Meta observer authority
47 selected target-train successful members and trajectories
held5 source/shared/direct paired baselines and evaluator
missing_derived_assets: one namespaced 90-fit plus 5-held Stage 1 task/member authority
successful occupancy trajectories for all 71 nonheld experts in ECP phase/owner format
one combined task-equal Stage 1 schedule and checkpoint schema
one 90-task-equal structured fit success/progress calibration panel

existing_occupancy_limit.decision: insufficient for 71-task Stage 1 training and must not be counted as broad coverage

derivation_plan.trajectory_capture: replay at most two already-identified successful rows per nonheld task, preferring one source-to-direct gained row and one retained-success row when available
derivation_plan.support_build: query existing step1000 experts and frozen source/shared policies on cross-episode successful occupancy; retain event, owner, horizon and member uncertainty structure
derivation_plan.fit_closed_loop: one task-equal structured success/progress calibration after the 540 dense visits; no global 16D estimator

known_limitations: The 71 nonheld mappings are source-seen and therefore only increase shared mapping diversity; held5 remains the source-unseen oracle.
Each nonheld task has one independently trained adapter. Two trajectories improve occupancy coverage but are not two independent policy mappings.
Fifteen nonheld experts score below source on the fixed paired rows; they remain valid successful-policy members but source/shared preservation is mandatory.
The current metadata still does not establish equal-endpoint different-valid-procedure pairs, so this audit does not authorize a process-identifiability claim.
